get.description: Returns information about a given Variable Recurring Payment consent.

400.description: The consent details cannot be retrieved as it does not exist

aspspId.description: Identifier of the payer’s ASPSP where the consent will be created. The ASPSP must have the "SWEEPING" or "COMMERCIAL" capability enabled (which can be checked using our API).

destination.description: Destination account details that will receive variable recurring payments initiated using this consent.

paymentConstraints.description: Limits that will apply to payments initiated using this consent.

reference.description: Reference to be used for the Consent. This will appear on the Account statement/the recipient's bank account. Min 6 to max 18 characters. Can contain alphanumeric, '-', '.', '&', '/' and space.

validFromDate.description: Start date time from which payments can be initiated using this consent. Must be specified using YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.

validToDate.description: End date time after which payments cannot be initiated using this consent. Must be specified using YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.

type.description: Type of VRP consent that will be created.

status.description: The current status of the VRP consent.

interactionTypes.description: List of PSU interaction types permitted under this consent. Must be one or both of IN_SESSION (customer is present), OFF_SESSION (customer is not present)

ultimateCreditor.description: The ultimate beneficiary of the payment, party to which an amount of money is due. Provided if different from the immediate creditor.

ultimateDebtor.description: The ultimate payer, party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor. Provided if different from the account holder.

risk.description: Additional details used for risk scoring for Payments.

pispgateway.PeriodicLimit.description: Maximum amount of all payments that can be initiated using this consent in a given period. If the periodAlignment is “Calendar”, the limit is pro-rated in the first period to the remaining number of days.

currency.description: Currency of the maximum amount. Must be specified in ISO 4217 format.

amount.description: The maximum amount of all payments initiated using this consent in the specified period. At least one periodic limit is required - '1' = 1.00 GBP

periodAlignment.description: Specifies whether the period starts on the date of consent creation or lines up with a calendar.

periodType.description: Period type. Must be one of “DAY”,”WEEK”,”FORTNIGHT”,”MONTH”,”HALF_YEAR”,”YEAR”.

name.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

lei.description: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a party. Legal Entity Identifier is a code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442 Financial Services - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI).

postalAddress.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

pispgateway.PaymentConstraints.description: Limits that will apply to payments initiated using this consent.

maximumIndividualAmount.description: Maximum amount of any single payment initiated using this consent.

periodicLimits.description: Maximum amount of all payments that can be initiated using this consent in a given period. If the periodAlignment is “Calendar”, the limit is pro-rated in the first period to the remaining number of days.

pispgateway.MaximumIndividualVrPayment.description: Maximum amount of any single payment initiated using this consent.

currency.description: Currency of the maximum individual amount. Must be specified in ISO 4217 format.

amount.description: Maximum amount of any single payment initiated using this consent - '1' = 1.00 GBP

pispgateway.Destination.description: The destination account for the payment

type.description: Indicates the type of destination. Can be one of ACCOUNT, SCAN

id.description: Identifier of the destination account if using ACCOUNT type

accountNumber.description: Account Number of destination account if using SCAN type

sortCode.description: Sort Code of destination account if using SCAN type

name.description: Name of destination account if using SCAN type (this may be truncated)

addressType.description: Identifies the nature of the postal address. BIZZ (Business), DLVY (Delivery), MLTO (Mail To), PBOX (PO Box), ADDR (Postal), HOME (Residential), CORR (Correspondence), STAT (Statement).

department.description: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building.

subDepartment.description: Identification of a sub-division of a large organisation or building.

streetName.description: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

buildingNumber.description: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

floor.description: Number that identifies the level within a building.

unitNumber.description: Number that identifies the unit of a specific address.

room.description: Information that locates and identifies a room to form part of an address.

postBox.description: Information that locates and identifies a box in a post office assigned to a person or organization, where letters for them are kept until called for.

townLocationName.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

districtName.description: Number that of the regional area, known as a district, which forms part of an address.

careOf.description: The 'care of' address is used whenever sending mail to a person or organisation who does not actually live or work at the address. They will receive the mail for the individual.

postCode.description: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

townName.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

countrySubDivision.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country such as state, region, county.

country.description: Nation with its own government, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

addressLine.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services, presented in free format text. Maximum 7 lines, each up to 70 characters.

merchantCategoryCode.description: Category code conforming to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides.

merchantCustomerIdentification.description: The unique customer identifier of the PSU with the merchant.

contractPresentIndicator.description: Indicates if Payee has a contractual relationship with the PISP.

beneficiaryPrepopulatedIndicator.description: Indicates if PISP has immutably prepopulated payment details for the PSU.

beneficiaryAccountType.description: Specifies the extended type of beneficiary account if known.

deliveryAddress.description: Information that locates and identifies a delivery address.
